Technical Skills:
I have a growing interest in Machine Learning and am currently pursuing Andrew Ng’s Machine 
Learning Certification. I’ve applied my learning in small projects like:
• Digit Recognition – a project to classify handwritten digits.
• Wine Voting Classifier – a machine learning model to classify wine ratings,etc
I also have Python programming skills and basic front-end development knowledge in HTML, CSS, 
and JavaScript, which allows me to build simple web applications.
Event Management:
I’ve organized small events during school and participated as an anchor in many programs. This 
taught me
• How events are planned.
• The various roles and teamwork.
• Distribution of tasks and coordination.
With guidance from seniors, I can learn the college rules, event organization procedures, and 
protocols to be followed, and I believe I can be of help.
